on_screen_text.text: At the Department of State, our number one priority is the safety and the security of American citizens everywhere in the world. Now, with what's going on in the Middle East with Operation Epic Fury and the cowardly attacks that we're seeing from Iran... I wanted to take this chance to speak directly to Americans who are in the Middle East... we are doing to try to keep you safe. So immediately following the beginning of this operation, at my direction, the State Department activated a 24/7 task force... to help provide American citizens with up to the minute safety and security information. ...you have to register with the Smart Traveller Enrollment Program. You have to register with STEP and here's where you do it.
We also encourage Americans abroad to follow our security updates for U.S. Citizens channel on WhatsApp and follow @Travelgov on social media as well.

spoken_summary: Marco Rubio addresses American citizens in the Middle East, stating their safety is the State Department's top priority. He cites 'Operation Epic Fury' and 'cowardly attacks from Iran' as reasons for heightened concern. He announces that the State Department has activated a 24/7 task force and urges citizens to register with the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at step.state.gov for safety updates. He also directs them to follow @Travel.gov on social media, use a WhatsApp channel, check travel.state.gov, and provides a 24/7 phone number (1-202-501-4444) for assistance.
